name: Resource page link building

name: Broken link building

name: Unlinked brand mention reclamation
notes: Highest conversion rate of any tactic: someone already named you, just ask for the link. Run the mentions monitor, then the one-line reclamation template.

name: Guest posting / contributed articles
notes: Only on sites with real editorial standards and real readers. Never pay for placement on a link farm - that is exactly the footprint manual actions look for.

name: Digital PR / original data study

name: Supplier / partner / customer pages

name: Local sponsorship & community pages

name: Local chamber of commerce / trade body
notes: Paid membership usually includes a dofollow member listing on a genuinely authoritative local domain.

name: Journalist request platforms (HARO-style)
